planets.name: TOI-2096 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2096 with a 6.39-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-2096 c was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-2096. Its orbit and size follow Pozuelos et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
